description: Range reads (RANGE-1, RANGE-2, QUERY-2): bounds, limits and boundaries of pages, row groups and parts. Expected rows come from oracle.py.

families.range/bounds: start, end, exclusivity, empty and null bounds, and limits on basic
families.range/boundary-page: five probes around each page boundary of the written layout (start at the first key after it, exclusive and inclusive start at the last key before it, start just above that key, end at the first key after it); at most four page boundaries per dataset
families.range/boundary-row-group: five probes around each row group boundary of the written layout (start at the first key after it, exclusive and inclusive start at the last key before it, start just above that key, end at the first key after it); at most four page boundaries per dataset
families.range/boundary-part: five probes around each part boundary of the written layout (start at the first key after it, exclusive and inclusive start at the last key before it, start just above that key, end at the first key after it); at most four page boundaries per dataset
families.range/whole-dataset: every row of a dataset, with columns
families.range/seek-key: start exactly at every key of binary-keys, on the exact-bounds layout and on both shortened-bounds layouts; limit 1
families.range/start-just-above-key: start at key + 0x00 for every key, limit 1: the first key at or after it, which may be an existing key (the case ids say seek-miss for historical reasons; the probe is not necessarily a miss)
families.range/end-at-key: end exactly at every key on the 2-byte shortened bounds, start at its first byte
families.range/seek-with-columns: start at every key with limit 2 and all scalar columns, on layouts with unusual indexes, encodings or annotations
